title: Make a Greeting
description:
Write a function `make_greeting(name, age)` that returns a greeting string in the format:

`"Hello, {name}! You are {age} years old."`

**Examples:**
```python
make_greeting("Alice", 25)  # 'Hello, Alice! You are 25 years old.'
make_greeting("Bob", 30)    # 'Hello, Bob! You are 30 years old.'
```

**Hint:** Use an f-string: `f"Hello, {name}!"`
solutionCode:
def make_greeting(name, age):
    return f"Hello, {name}! You are {age} years old."

tests.name: Alice 25
tests.expectedOutput: Hello, Alice! You are 25 years old.

tests.name: Bob 30
tests.expectedOutput: Hello, Bob! You are 30 years old.

tests.name: age 0
tests.expectedOutput: Hello, Baby! You are 0 years old.

tests.name: longer name
tests.expectedOutput: Hello, Vedant! You are 21 years old.
